description: Attorney General Brenna Bird is suing Wi-Fi router maker TP-Link, claiming the company hid its ties to China and that the Chinese Communist Party could potentially access Iowans' devices. Her office said the suit is the first in a series of actions she plans to take against China-aligned businesses over the coming week. Read more here
